doc: The harness over MCP, for an agent that is not Claude Code. Read-only by construction: every tool is a harness task that describes work, and there is no tool for one that records, dispatches or verifies. `Noetic.Harness.MCP` holds the allow-list of tasks and the flag each must carry, and `mix harness.validate` refuses this file when a tool steps outside it. Served over stdio by `noetic-harness mcp`, one process per client: no socket, no port, nothing in a release. Arguments reach the task as `--flag=value`, one argv element each, so a value cannot become a second flag.

tools.name: harness_route
tools.description: Which workflow a piece of work routes to, which gate lane it will have to pass, and who should do it. Call it before starting non-trivial work.

args.description: A role id, e.g. backend.otp_architect. `harness_workflows` and `.agents/AGENTS_INDEX.md` list them.

tools.description: The workflows this repository develops itself by, or one workflow's steps in order with the gates each must pass.

tools.description: Which gates a change to these paths will have to pass, resolved without running any of them.

args.name: lane
args.description: fast, focused, full or evolution. `harness_route` names the lane.

tools.name: harness_memory
tools.description: What earlier work in this repository learned about a subject: lessons, decisions and their confidence.

args.name: query
args.description: A word or phrase, e.g. typedb or resident.

tools.name: harness_environment_brief
tools.description: The brief of one evaluation environment: a task derived from a real commit, as a dispatched agent would be given it.

tools.name: harness_classify
tools.description: Where a failure routes: which failure class the evidence belongs to, and what the harness does about that class.

args.name: evidence
args.description: The failure text: a test failure, an error, a gate's output.

tools.name: harness_kb_query
tools.description: Ask the project's knowledge base (docs/kb/extraction): the concepts, requirements, decisions, gaps and contradictions that answer a question, each with its id, group, matched text and source files. Russian or English.

args.name: query
args.description: Words or a phrase, e.g. «память робота» or hooded cloak.

args.name: group
args.description: Only this group: G3, or G3_harbour_lights.

args.name: kind
args.description: Only this kind: concept, requirement, decision, gap, contradiction …
